summary: IperionX Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing operational validation of its GenX continuous HAMR titanium production platform, not a special-situation transaction. Four campaigns processed over 500 kg across 41 hours at roughly 12 kg/hour; oxygen results met ASTM Grade 5 for angular powder and Grade 23 for spherical. The company cites six times batch throughput, over 75% lower energy intensity, and reduced magnesium and hydrogen use. Next-stage optimization is slated for Q4 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
